Step 3. Consider the projective operator \(B_{01340013}\) acting on the Riemann surface. By the projective decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{01340013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01340013\).

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via rational interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
